patches.old: This pattern means you never lose more than one increment of work. If an agent goes off the rails, `git reset --hard HEAD` takes you back to the last successful state.
patches.new: Save points preserve completed work. If an increment fails, inspect the current status and diff, then apply a targeted inverse patch only to changes you own. Preserve unrelated staged, unstaged, and untracked work. Do not use a destructive reset or clean as a recovery shortcut; when ownership is uncertain, leave the files intact and record the blocker.
patches.reason: Preserve user and concurrent work; remove destructive recovery recommendation.
